articles.headline: Von Miller signing with Cowboys on 1-year deal, source says
articles.description: Future Hall of Fame pass rusher Von Miller is coming home, agreeing to a one-year deal with the Dallas Cowboys.

articles.headline: Sources: Cardinals RB Love likely to sit rest of preseason
articles.description: Rookie running back Jeremiyah Love, who played 23 snaps Thursday against the Las Vegas Raiders, is dealing with a high ankle sprain and is unlikely to play the rest of the preseason for the Arizona Cardinals, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Sunday.

articles.headline: Minnesota Vikings lose Adams for season due to knee injury
articles.description: Veteran defender Jamal Adams will miss the 2026 season because of a right knee injury he suffered Saturday in the Minnesota Vikings' 13-10 preseason victory over the New York Giants, the NFL Network reported Sunday.

articles.headline: Ed Dodds suggests Colts will keep Anthony Richardson for depth
articles.description: Colts assistant general manager Ed Dodds suggested Sunday that Anthony Richardson Sr. will remain in Indianapolis because the Colts intend to prioritize quarterback depth.

articles.headline: John Niland, who helped Cowboys win 1st Super Bowl, dies at 82
articles.description: John Niland, a three-time All-Pro guard who helped the Cowboys win their first Super Bowl championship, died Saturday. He was 82.
